in_hebrew.name: Adwoa
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו God is born
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Adwoa הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. The name Adwoa is of Akan origin, which is spoken in Ghana. It is a feminine name that means 'God is born'. Adwoa is a common name in Ghana and is used to celebrate the birth of a child. It is a name full of faith and hope, reflecting the joy and gratitude felt by parents for the arrival of their newborn.
